annotations.title: Upload a file to the media library

description:
[Admin] Upload a file to the company's media library and return it, ready to use.

Sends the file (base64) and has it checked: its real type, the codec of a
video, and anything active in an SVG, which is refused rather than cleaned.
The returned `file.url` is what page blocks, brand logos and font settings take.
The library is public: a file can be reached by anyone with its address.
Switched on per company by JobMojito; while it is off this is refused with 403.

A file too large to pass as an argument goes through start_media_upload and
finish_media_upload, for a client that can send a file to an address.

content_type.description: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, image/avif, image/svg+xml, video/mp4 (H.264 only), audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/x-m4a or font/woff2.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

duration_seconds.description: Length of a video or audio file in seconds.

file.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. At most 50 MB once decoded.

file_name.description: Display name in the library, such as team-photo.jpg. No slashes.

folder.description: Library folder, one level, such as Crew life (list_media_files include_folders=true gives the names). Default: the top. A new name makes the folder.

height.description: Height in pixels of an image or video.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Only for an account acting for a sub-merchant; omit for your own company.

poster_url.description: For a video: the url of an image already in this company's library, shown before it plays.

replace_media_id.description: Replace this file instead of adding one. It must be the same kind, and page drafts move to the new address.

width.description: Width in pixels of an image or video.
